build_wrapper_class: build a DepthUVToFootPlacementWrapper to convert depth map UV actions to world frame foot placement for a quadruped robot
create_reset_env: create a reset call on the wrapper to reinitialize the robot COM and foot positions for a new episode
test_step_action: test the step method by passing a 2D UV action array to move the swing leg to a target foothold
refactor_foot_trajectories: refactor the _construct_foot_trajectories method to customize the swing foot trajectory interpolation and clearance height
review_com_movement: review the _move_com_dynamic method that shifts the robot center of mass toward the support polygon center
